test_case.test_name: Target-bound BlueField PCIe identity and negotiated-link conformance
test_case.purpose: Prove the intended BlueField DPU is present at its approved PCIe address and that its numeric identity, subsystem, capabilities and negotiated link match the signed platform specification without changing DPU firmware or host runtime state.
required_package: BlueField model/serial/PSID/slot and verified domain:BDF map
Expected vendor/device/subsystem IDs, BlueField generation/function inventory, PCIe generation/width and relevant capability field matrix
Pinned pciutils version and local PCI-ID database provenance
Approval either to use the existing/offline pinned PCI-ID database or to run state-changing `update-pciids`
Protected evidence path and pre/post PCIe/AER/platform logs
test_case.test_command: With the target and SPEC matrix approved, preserve existing logs; collect the full local `lspci -Dnn` inventory, bind the BlueField numeric functions to the signed serial/SKU/slot/BDF map, then retain `lspci -D -s <verified-domain:BDF> -nnvvv` for every required function and compare each declared identity/capability/link field. Run `update-pciids` only under separate database/network approval; do not install DOCA/BFB, flash firmware or reboot.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly the approved BlueField functions appear at the mapped BDFs; numeric vendor/device/subsystem IDs, capabilities, expected PCIe generation/width and negotiated link fields match the signed matrix; no required function is missing or duplicated and no new PCIe/AER/platform anomaly occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires serial/SKU/slot-to-BDF provenance, complete numeric inventory, full exact-BDF verbose output and explicit comparison of every signed field. A product-name grep, truncated output or unrelated Mellanox device cannot pass; package install or firmware success does not count toward this coverage.
safety_gate: Verify the target BDF from independent serial/SKU/slot mapping rather than grep text
Treat `update-pciids` as a host database/network change and skip it when a pinned local numeric-ID method suffices unless approved
Preserve complete logs and prohibit DOCA/BFB install, flash or reboot in this row
Stop on disappearance, unexpected function, link downgrade/retrain or new PCIe/AER error; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: BlueField model/serial/PSID/slot/BDF map and signed expected-field matrix
pciutils version and PCI-ID database provenance/update decision
Full `lspci -Dnn` inventory and full `-nnvvv` output for each verified function
Pre/post AER/kernel/BMC/platform evidence and no-state-change audit
test_case.recovery: The approved path is read-only. If a link/function changes or disappears, preserve evidence and stop; do not rescan, reset, flash or reboot automatically. Use the separately approved PCIe/DPU recovery runbook and OOB access, while any PCI-ID database update is rolled back from its pinned copy if required.
